metadata.title: Uniqueness and Stability of Monge--Ampère Potentials in Big Cohomology Classes
metadata.abstract: In this paper, we establish a stability estimate and a uniform estimate for the modulus of continuity of solutions to the degenerate complex Monge-Ampère equation in big cohomology classes. Consequently, we prove the uniqueness of solutions to complex Monge-Ampère mean field equations for a sufficiently small parameter.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.workSummary: 为大上同调类中的退化复 Monge--Ampère 方程建立稳定性和一致连续模估计，并推出小参数平均场方程解的唯一性。
analysis.breakthrough: 在退化大类中同时获得定量稳定与正则控制，并用于唯一性。
analysis.limitations: 摘要未列出测度密度和小参数阈值的精确条件。
analysis.priorityReason: 按相关性、新颖性、技术复用性、潜在影响与证据清晰度综合评分为 72/100。
